lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਇਤੀ ਆਸ ਕਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa itee aas k aas puraaeeai ||
lines.translation: My hope is so intense, that this hope alone should fulfill my hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhae daiaal ta pooraa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then I attain the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai tan avagan bahut k avagan chhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My body is filled with so many demerits; I am covered with faults and demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) satigur bhae daiaal ta man thaharaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: O Lord! When the True Guru becomes Merciful, then the mind is held in place. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bea(n)t bea(n)t dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have meditated on the Lord, Infinite and Endless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dutar ihu sa(n)saar satiguroo taraaiaa ||
lines.translation: This world-ocean is so difficult to cross; the True Guru has carried me across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਜਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitiaa aavaa gaun jaa(n) pooraa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: My comings and goings in reincarnation ended, when I met the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) a(n)mrit har kaa naam satigur te paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: O Lord! I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord from the True Guru. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਆਗਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai haath padam aagan sukh baasanaa ||
lines.translation: The lotus is in my hand; in the courtyard of my heart I abide in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮੋਰੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee morai ka(n)th rata(n)n pekh dukh naasanaa ||
lines.translation: O my companion, the Jewel is around my neck; beholding it, sorrow is taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baasau sa(n)g gupaal sagal sukh raas har ||
lines.translation: I abide with the Lord of the World, the Treasury of Total Peace. O Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) ridh sidh nav nidh basahi jis sadaa kar ||7||
lines.translation: All wealth, spiritual perfection and the nine treasures are in His Hand. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਤਾ ਲਾਜੀਅਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: par tri raavan jaahi seee taa laajeeahi ||
lines.translation: Those men who go out to enjoy other men's women shall suffer in shame.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਕਤ ਢਾਕੀਅਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nitaprat hirahi par darab chhidr kat dhaakeeahi ||
lines.translation: Those who steal the wealth of others - how can their guilt be concealed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun ramat pavitr sagal kul taaraee ||
lines.translation: Those who chant the Sacred Praises of the Lord save and redeem all their generations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) sunate bhae puneet paarabraham beechaaraee ||8||
lines.translation: O Lord! Those who listen and contemplate the Supreme Lord God become pure and holy. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਬਨੈ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਤਲੈ ਧਰ ਸੋਹਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oopar banai akaas talai dhar sohatee ||
lines.translation: The sky above looks lovely, and the earth below is beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਮਕੈ ਬੀਜੁਲਿ ਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis chamakai beejul mukh kau johatee ||
lines.translation: Lightning flashes in the ten directions; I behold the Face of my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਪੀਉ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat phirau bides peeu kat paaeeai ||
lines.translation: If I go searching in foreign lands, how can I find my Beloved?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) je masatak hovai bhaag ta daras samaaeeai ||9||
lines.translation: O Lord! If such destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, I am absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭੇ ਥਾਵ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dithe sabhe thaav nahee tudh jehiaa ||
lines.translation: I have seen all places, but none can compare to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਧੋਹੁ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: badhohu purakh bidhaatai taa(n) too sohiaa ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has established You; thus You are adorned and embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਦੀ ਸਘਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: vasadee saghan apaar anoop raamadaas pur ||
lines.translation: Ramdaspur is prosperous and thickly populated, and incomparably beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਇਐ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) naanak kasamal jaahi naaiai raamadaas sar ||10||
lines.translation: O Lord! Bathing in the Sacred Pool of Raam Daas, the sins are washed away, O Nanak. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਸੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਚਾਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaatrik chit suchit s saajan chaaheeai ||
lines.translation: The rainbird is very smart; in its consciousness, it longs for the friendly rain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਆਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis sa(n)g laage praan tisai kau aaheeai ||
lines.translation: It longs for that, to which its breath of life is attached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban ban phirat udaas boo(n)d jal kaarane ||
lines.translation: It wanders depressed, from forest to forest, for the sake of a drop of water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) tiu har jan maa(n)gai naam naanak balihaarane ||11||
lines.translation: O Lord! In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮਰੰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mit kaa chit anoop mara(n)m na jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The Consciousness of my Friend is incomparably beautiful. Its mystery cannot be known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਹਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaahak gunee apaar s tat pachhaaneeai ||
lines.translation: One who purchases the priceless virtues realizes the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਸਮਾਇ ਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitahi chit samaai ta hovai ra(n)g ghanaa ||
lines.translation: When the consciousness is absorbed in the supreme consciousness, great joy and bliss are found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੋਰਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) cha(n)chal chorahi maar ta paavahi sach dhanaa ||12||
lines.translation: O Lord! When the fickle thieves are overcome, the true wealth is obtained. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਊਭੀ ਭਈ ਗਹਿਓ ਕੀ ਨ ਅੰਚਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: supanai oobhee bhaee gahio kee na a(n)chalaa ||
lines.translation: In a dream, I was lifted up; why didn't I grasp the hem of His Robe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੰਚਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar purakh biraajit pekh man ba(n)chalaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Beautiful Lord relaxing there, my mind was charmed and fascinated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojau taa ke charan kahahu kat paaeeai ||
lines.translation: I am searching for His Feet - tell me, where can I find Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੰਨੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) soee jata(n)n bataai sakhee priu paaeeai ||13||
lines.translation: O Lord! Tell me how I can find my Beloved, O my companion. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਿ ਨੈਣ ਬਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nain na dekhahi saadh s nain bihaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The eyes which do not see the Holy - those eyes are miserable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਰਨ ਮੁੰਦਿ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan na sunahee naad karan mu(n)d ghaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The ears which do not hear the Sound-current of the Naad - those ears might just as well be plugged.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa japai na naam til til kar kateeai ||
lines.translation: The tongue which does not chant the Naam ought to be cut out, bit by bit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ਦਿਨੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) jab bisarai gobid raai dino din ghateeai ||14||
lines.translation: O Lord! When the mortal forgets the Lord of the Universe, the Sovereign Lord King, he grows weaker day by day. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜ ਫਾਥੇ ਪੰਕ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਗੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)kaj phaathe pa(n)k mahaa mad gu(n)phiaa ||
lines.translation: The wings of the bumble bee are caught in the intoxicating fragrant petals of the lotus.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਸੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g urajhaai bisarate su(n)phiaa ||
lines.translation: With its limbs entangled in the petals, it loses its senses.
